what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7111 Ethiopian refugees in the United States, 4.3% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia from 1983 to 1991 and from 2020 to 2022, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflicts over Oromiya and Ogaden territory in periods from 1983.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 10439 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 24853, at the end of 2006.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1991 to 1995 and 2002 to 2008, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
